senses.gloss: new moon, i.e. the first appearance of the crescent.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:9">R. Hash. I, 9</cite>, a. e. <he>מי שראה את הח׳</he> he who sees the new moon (when it was his duty to travel to the place of the Supreme Court to testify).
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:9">Ib.</cite> <he>יוצאין לעדות הח׳</he> they travel for the purpose of testifying to the sight of the new moon; a. fr.
Snh. V, 1 באיזה ח׳ in what month?; בכמה בַּח׳ on what day of the month?; a. v. fr.—ראש ח׳ (abbr. ר״ח) the first day of the month, the festival of New Moon.

<cite ref="Megillah 21b:17">Meg. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>פרשת ר״ח</he> the section of the Law read on the New Moon Day (<cite ref="Numbers 28:1-15">Num. XXVIII, 1—15</cite>); a. fr.—Pl. <he>חֳדָשִׁים</he>. Ib. III, 4 <he>בראשי ח׳</he> on New Moon Days.
<cite ref="Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:3">R. Hash. I, 3</cite> <he>על ששה ח׳ וכ׳</he> for the proclamation of six New Moon Days messengers are sent abroad.

<cite ref="Ketubot 60a:14">Keth. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>שלשה ח׳</he> at an age of three months; a. fr. [Pesik. Baḥod., p. 154ᵇ <he>ניטש מח׳ וכ׳</he>, read <cite ref="H00482"><he>חוֹרֶשׁ</he></cite>.—Y. Shebi. IV, 35ᵇ bot. <he>בחדשי׳</he>, read <he>בחרשי׳</he>, v. <cite ref="H00482"><he>חוֹרֶשׁ</he></cite>.]
